no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was held for this NDA.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA210496 (BRAFTOVI, encorafenib). The Multidisciplinary Review's Section 9 (Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations) states plainly that no AC meeting was held for this NDA, so the committee had no influence on the approval. There are therefore no AC-concern-to-change linkages to report.
